name: Ricochet Reaper
desc: A frantic arena shooter where your scythe laser bounces off the arena walls and pillars — the best shots are complicated ricochets, and a bounced shot scores more, releases more souls and is the only way to hit a shielded knight from the front. Every kill releases souls that fly back to you and refill your limited laser charge; chain kills multiply your score and survive ever more aggressive waves. An original Arcade Phantasm game.
controls: WASD move, mouse aims, click fires (or arrows + Q/E aim + Space); P pause, M mute
creator: CursedPrograms
